symptom: A required merge commit was blocked with spawnSync git ENOBUFS before the Ponytail review could inspect its staged diff.
direct_cause: The hook used execFileSync with a 1.5 MB maxBuffer while a legitimate refreshed-main merge produced a 7.25 MB text diff.
class_root: The shared Git review boundary sized its subprocess buffer to a small ordinary-commit case instead of the documented bounded diff ceiling, so it failed with an infrastructure error rather than its explicit size guard.
affected_population: mainline merges with several megabytes of text changes
any staged or outgoing review whose exact text diff is below the new bounded ceiling
internal_only_reason: This is an internal Git-hook subprocess invariant; the failure and fix are determined by the repository hook implementation and its regression tests.
invariants: The subprocess maxBuffer must exceed the explicit exact-diff ceiling.
Text diffs at or below the bounded ceiling remain exact and reviewable.
Text diffs over the ceiling fail through the explicit review-size guard, not an incidental subprocess buffer error.
Binary payloads remain summarized rather than expanding the text review input.
generality_proof: Both commit and push paths converge on collectReviewDiff and runGit; sizing the shared buffer above the shared ceiling fixes the class for staged and outgoing reviews without weakening the fail-closed ceiling.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Collect the exact staged or outgoing diff with a subprocess buffer larger than the explicit review ceiling, then reject only genuinely oversized text.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The reproduced merge failure occurred while collecting the staged merge tree.
Push ranges use the same runGit helper and the same explicit MAX_REVIEW_DIFF_BYTES assertion.

recurrence.reason: The same size mismatch can recur for any future merge or large text change, independent of vendor or feature.
same_class_scan: Checked both staged and push branches of collectReviewDiff; both call runGit and assert the shared ceiling.
Checked the existing binary-summary path; binary bytes are already excluded and therefore are not the cause of this text-buffer failure.
Added a 7.5 MB staged text regression to exercise the previously failing class below the new 8 MB ceiling, while retaining the over-ceiling rejection test.

prevention.invariant: runGit maxBuffer is MAX_REVIEW_DIFF_BYTES + 64 KB, so the explicit review ceiling is reached before subprocess buffering fails.
prevention.failure_mode: A diff over MAX_REVIEW_DIFF_BYTES is rejected with a review-size error; subprocess collection remains bounded.
prevention.strategy: Keep one shared finite ceiling and allocate the subprocess buffer above it for both Git-hook entry points.

legacy_paths.rationale: No obsolete review path exists; the same staged and push collection boundary is retained and strengthened.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure is in the repository's Node subprocess configuration, not a third-party runtime.

migration: No stored data or user state is affected.
residual_risks: An exact text diff above 8 MB remains intentionally blocked and must be split into smaller commits or reviewed through a future bounded adapter design.
